name: set_spec
description: Replace the whole Vega-Lite spec (a JSON object). Tables are read with {"data": {"name": id}}.

name: patch_spec
description: Set one value in the spec at a JSON pointer such as /encoding/x/field (/- appends to an array). The value is JSON as itself (an object, not its JSON text). The parent must exist: with no /encoding/color, set it to {"field": "region", "type": "nominal"}, not /encoding/color/field.

name: remove_spec_key
description: Remove the value at a JSON pointer from the spec.

name: set_table
description: Replace a table's rows, or add a table with this id; rows is an array of objects.

name: reorder_tables
description: Move a table to index (0 is first): the order the spec's datasets list them in.

name: compile_report
description: Whether the spec compiles: errors, warnings, the tables and the Vega marks it makes.

name: describe_tables
description: Every table's columns with type, min, max, distinct and null counts, and 3 sample rows.

name: render_svg
description: Render the chart to SVG off screen: its size and the runtime errors and warnings.
